_setup: Add your own client/brand keywords to path_hints — any file whose path contains a hint gets that class. Tools call Tools/security_gate.py gate() before sending anything to a cloud service.

classes.PUBLIC: Already public or explicitly approved for public processing.
classes.INTERNAL: Ordinary day-to-day work; local processing by default.
classes.CONFIDENTIAL: Employees, meetings, unreleased campaigns or sensitive business content; local only.
classes.CLIENT_RESTRICTED: Client, partner or contract-sensitive content; local only unless written approval exists.
